title: 第一卷 第15章 太极拳效果第一卷 第16章 逐渐强壮
content_zh:
【太极拳熟练度+1】
“呼~”
李乘风正将最后一遍太极拳练完，满身汗水，听到玉娘的话，也就笑着点了点头，站起身来，用干毛巾擦了擦身上的汗，端着饭，抱着羊肉汤，大口大口地吃饱。
吃饱后，他没有急着立即去睡午觉休息，而是又深呼着气，忍着疲惫练了一遍太极拳。
直到一遍练完，肚子里的饭菜稍稍消化了，再躺到床上睡了个午觉。
刘玉娘跟在他身边，见他躺床上睡了不过两刻钟，就又重新起来继续练武。
见着在阳光下不断挥洒汗水，练着自然和谐动作的李乘风，刘玉娘越发觉得自家的这个男人长大了。
“......”
在家修炼之中，时间眨眼间又过去了三日。
三日时间，除了进集市买菜以外，李乘风大门不出，二门不迈，一心在院中吃肉、练武。
直到这天傍晚，一个慌里慌张的邻居，急急忙忙地跑过李乘风的院子，见到在竹林里不知道干什么晃来晃去的李乘风忽然想到什么，忍不住眉宇间带着喜色地对他喊了一句：“李乘风，刘宏死了！”
“什么？刘宏死了？”
为了避免别人偷学，一直在用院子和竹林挡着视野练太极拳的李乘风闻言顿时眼里闪过一抹精光，直接从竹林里跑过去，神色里露着十足的欣喜，“他居然死了，太好了！哈哈哈！”
“嘿，这个祸害确实死得好！”
那邻居看着李乘风手舞足蹈的样子，想到他被刘宏抢了工钱的事情，摇了摇脑袋，颇有些同情地说了一句，随后咂了咂嘴，加快步子走了，“现在都在瞧刘宏的尸体呢，他哥刘勇，脸色可阴沉了，我去叫些人一块去瞧瞧去......”
对方说着，好像遇到了什么难得一见的稀罕事一般，特别高兴，加快了步子从李乘风门口离开了。
“乘风！”
见那邻居离开，一边听到刘宏死讯而感到身上有些僵硬的刘玉娘，忍不住面带担忧地看向了他，口中轻唤。
“没事，不要紧张玉娘。他要是知道是谁杀的他，有证据的话，早就来找咱了。”
李乘风看着刘玉娘的反应，笑着走过去拍了拍她的手，出声安慰，“你什么都不要想，好好在家吃着喝着养着就行。”

“嗳，好！”
刘玉娘闻言连连点头，本来还是有些紧张，但是见到李乘风说完之后，就继续慢条斯理地走到一边练武，心也就慢慢跟着定了下来。
她缓了缓气，也跟着起来练起了李乘风这几天抽空教给她学全了的八段锦。
就这么沉静地一直练到天黑时分，也没有任何人找到门来，刘玉娘彻底地放下心来，起身去把中午做好的羊肉，剩下的热了热，端出来和李乘风一起吃。
“呼～”
李乘风端着饭，大口吃着羊肉，眼睛里闪烁着神采。
‘五天才发现死人，怕不是尸体臭了才发现的，我那天又把箭口用刀捅了，破坏了一番，再等他们把尸体找仵作，鉴出结果了，又要几天。’
李乘风心中转动，又涌现了另一个念头，“那长工刘勇居然是刘宏的哥，哼，我被刘宏抢钱的事，刘勇绝对也脱不了干系，正好，此事一发生，只怕还能多拖几天，给我充分的时间准备。”
李乘风心中念动，随后算上今天第四天努力练武下来，感受着已经结实许多的身体，满意地大口吃饱了饭。
一顿饭下来，刘玉娘也更加放松，没那么担忧了。
她端起碗筷去洗漱，李乘风则在院子里又打了一趟拳，消了消食。
content_en:
[Tai Chi proficiency +1]
"Huh~"
Li Chengfeng was finishing the last Tai Chi practice and was covered in sweat. Hearing Yu Niang's words, he smiled and nodded, stood up, wiped the sweat on his body with a dry towel, held the rice, mutton soup, and ate with big mouthfuls.
After eating, he did not rush to take a nap immediately. Instead, he took a deep breath and practiced Tai Chi against fatigue.
After finishing the exercise, the food in my stomach was slightly digested, and then I lay down on the bed and took a nap.
Liu Yuniang followed him and saw that he lay on the bed and slept for less than two quarters of an hour before getting up again and continuing to practice martial arts.
Seeing Li Chengfeng sweating in the sun and practicing natural and harmonious movements, Liu Yuniang felt more and more that her man had grown up.
"..."
While practicing at home, three more days passed in the blink of an eye.
For three days, except for going to the market to buy vegetables, Li Chengfeng stayed at home eating meat and practicing martial arts in the courtyard.
Until that evening, a panicked neighbor hurriedly ran through Li Chengfeng's yard. When he saw Li Chengfeng wandering around in the bamboo forest for no apparent reason, something suddenly occurred to him. He couldn't help shouting to him with joy in his eyebrows: "Li Chengfeng, Liu Hong is dead!"
"What? Liu Hong is dead?"
In order to prevent others from stealing lessons, Li Chengfeng, who had been practicing Tai Chi with the yard and bamboo forest blocking his view, suddenly had a flash of light in his eyes when he heard this, and ran directly from the bamboo forest, his expression showing full joy, "He is actually dead, great! Hahaha!"
"Hey, this scourge did die well!"
The neighbor looked at Li Chengfeng dancing and thought about the fact that Liu Hong had robbed him of his wages. He shook his head and said something sympathetic. Then he smacked his lips and walked away quickly, "Everyone is looking at Liu Hong's body now. His brother Liu Yong's face is gloomy. I'll call some people to go and have a look..."
As the other party said this, he seemed to be very happy as if he had encountered something rare and rare. He quickened his pace and left from Li Chengfeng's door.
"Ride the wind!"
Seeing the neighbor leaving, Liu Yuniang, who felt a little stiff after hearing the news of Liu Hong's death, couldn't help but look at him with worry on her face and whispered.
"It's okay, don't be nervous, Yu Niang. If he knew who killed him and had evidence, he would have come to us long ago."
Li Chengfeng looked at Liu Yuniang's reaction, smiled, walked over, patted her hand, and comforted her, "Don't think about anything, just stay at home, eat, drink and take care of yourself."
"Hey, good!"
Liu Yuniang nodded repeatedly after hearing this. She was still a little nervous at first, but after seeing Li Chengfeng finish speaking, he continued to walk aside slowly to practice martial arts, and her heart slowly calmed down.
She took a breath and then got up to practice the Ba Duan Jin that Li Chengfeng had taken the time to teach her in the past few days.
They practiced quietly until dark, and no one came to the door. Liu Yuniang was completely relieved, got up, heated up the mutton she had cooked for noon, and took it out to eat with Li Chengfeng.
"Hoo~"
Li Chengfeng held the rice and ate the mutton with a gleam in his eyes.
"It took five days to discover the dead body. I'm afraid the body was not found because of the smell. I stabbed the arrow with a knife that day and destroyed it. It will take a few more days to wait for them to find the corpse and get the identification results." ’
Li Chengfeng's mind turned, and another thought came to his mind, "The long-term worker Liu Yong is actually Liu Hong's brother. Huh, Liu Yong is definitely involved in the fact that I was robbed of money by Liu Hong. It just so happens that once this happens, I'm afraid it will be delayed for a few more days, giving me enough time to prepare."
Li Chengfeng thought in his heart, and then counted it as the fourth day of hard martial arts practice today. Feeling that his body had become much stronger, he ate a full meal with satisfaction.
After the meal, Liu Yuniang became more relaxed., not so worried anymore.
She picked up the dishes and went to wash up, while Li Chengfeng punched again in the yard to eliminate the food.
